summary: --remote runs tests on an ephemeral cloud VM, recommended for integration tests that can't run in containers. It needs an API key unless in an approved Azure Pipelines org.
questions: How can I run ansible-test integration tests on a real VM?
Do I need an API key for ansible-test --remote?
Which OSes are available for ansible-test --remote?

answer_card.title: Run ansible-test on remote VMs
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `--remote` to run tests on a temporary cloud-hosted VM. It's meant for integration tests that can't run in containers.

You need an API key, unless you run inside an approved Azure Pipelines organization. List supported systems with `ansible-test <command> --help`.
